composition.motif: Ben Mua leitmotif: D major pentatonic question phrase hanging on scale degree 2; the full flute tail stays reserved for the resolve stinger and rift_finale
composition.structure: Additive phase-4 layer over boss_mang_cot (10 bars @ 66 bpm): double-time drums (beats + offbeats), alternating D1/D2 octave bass in 8ths, high D6 bell toll every 2 bars, minor-head pluck fragment doubled an octave up on bars 2 and 7 (the base's own statements). Phases 2/3 already fill the beats, the 8th/16th D1 pulse and the F4 bells, so phase 4 adds the offbeats, the octave bass and the high bell. No pad, no flute -- those stay in the base cue. -25 LUFS target; combined base+layer loudness measured from real bytes.

notes: Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

Each MD4 layer adds only what its base and the earlier layers do not already do: boss phase 4 goes double-time with octave bass and a high D6 bell (phases 2/3 already fill the beats and the F4 bells); swamp intensity adds the pulse a drumless base withholds; dungeon intensity fills beats 1/2/3 around the base's bar-line drum.

Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the MD4 files are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/layers/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, their cue bindings, or the checkpoint-26/30/MD1/MD2/MD3 cues.

No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes. Loop seams are recorded per looping cue in the delivery manifest: wrapJump after a disclosed 0.25 s end-landing loop construction, wrapJumpRaw before it.
